definitions.gloss: water-based paint; paint thinned with water
definitions.explanation: Paint that uses water as its solvent, so it can be thinned and cleaned up with water. Contrasts with oil-based paint.

examples.english: Paint a picture with water-based paint.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{水性|すいせい}{絵具|えのぐ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧だ。
examples.english: Water-based paint is safer for children.

examples.japanese: {水性|すいせい}{絵具|えのぐ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{乾|かわ}く→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{速|はや}く→速い：00514_hayai⟧、⟦{筆|ふで}→筆：03601_fude⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{洗|あら}う→洗う：00827_arau⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{片付|かたづ}けられる→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧。
examples.english: Water-based paint dries quickly, and you can clean up just by washing the brushes with water.

notes:
Composed of {水性|すいせい} (water-based) + {絵具|えのぐ} (paint, pigment). Common in schools and for hobby use because it is easy to handle and clean up.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水性|すいせい}{絵具|えのぐ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧: to paint with water-based paint
- {水性|すいせい}{絵具|えのぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{溶|と}く→溶く：26556_toku⟧: to thin water-based paint (with water)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{油性|ゆせい}{絵具|えのぐ}→油性絵具：29284_yuseienogu⟧: oil paint — uses oil as solvent, slower to dry, harder to clean up
- ⟦{水彩|すいさい}{絵具|えのぐ}→水彩絵具：25640_suisaienogu⟧: watercolor paint — a specific type of water-based paint for transparent washes
